settings.page_subtitle: Tune capture, recognition, AI polish, and output behavior. Changes are saved automatically.
settings.capture_desc: Choose how TypeX starts recording and which microphone it listens to.
settings.shortcut_need_modifier: Requires at least one modifier key (Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Super)
settings.asr_desc: Send microphone audio to an ASR provider and receive transcription text.
settings.endpoint_help: OpenAI-compatible base URL, for example https://api.openai.com/v1.
settings.endpoint_error: Endpoint must start with http:// or https://.
settings.api_key_help: Leave empty to use OPENAI_API_KEY or for local services that do not require a key.
settings.asr_model_help: Example: whisper-1 or the model name required by your compatible provider.
settings.asr_language_help: Optional language hint such as en, zh, or ja.
settings.llm_desc: Optionally improve punctuation, fluency, and clarity after transcription.
settings.llm_enabled_help: When enabled, transcription text is sent to the selected LLM before output.
settings.llm_model_help: Example: gpt-4o-mini or any model supported by your endpoint.
settings.llm_prompt_help: Leave empty to use TypeX's default text-polishing prompt.
settings.plugins_desc: Apply lightweight cleanup steps before optional AI polish.
settings.performance_note: (Not yet effective — coming in a future update)
settings.audio_device_help: The same device is used from the Record view and Settings.
settings.output_advanced_desc: Control how text is inserted and tune advanced runtime behavior.
settings.output_desc: Choose how TypeX inserts text and how much history to keep.
settings.appearance_desc: Control the app theme and display language.
settings.model_providers_desc: Save and switch independent ASR and LLM API connections.
settings.advanced_desc: System prompt, plugin pipeline, and experimental performance options.
settings.llm_disabled_advanced: Enable AI Polish above to configure provider, endpoint, model, and prompt.
